messages:
Mira Patel: Heads-up — experiment for the pricing page next Tues. Plan is a microcalculator + streamlined tier names + refreshed FAQ. Need copy + routing signoffs. @Alex @Jon can you take a look?

Alex Gomez: Sounds good. Quick q — what inputs should the calculator expose? tokens per call and calls/month? slider?

Jon Rivera: Keep it simple: tokens per call, calls/month, and concurrency note. Show both monthly estimate and per-request cost. For docs we can include the formula: `estimated_cost = tokens_per_call * calls_per_month * price_per_1000_tokens / 1000`.

Samir Kaur: +1 to monthly + per-request. Also add a tiny tooltip about cost controls (batching, cache, quantization) so people know how to lower it.

LaShawn Carter: On inbound routing — suggest routing leads with estimated MRR > $5k to AE queue, otherwise leave as self-serve nurture. What field will drive that?

Mira Patel: We'll surface a hidden field `estimated_mrr` from the calc. Carol, can HubSpot handle that rule?

Carol Chen: Yep — I can map `estimated_mrr` to a contact property and create two flows: "Est>5k -> Sales:Pricing-SME" and "Est<=5k -> Marketing:Nurture-Pricing". I'll draft the flows in Confluence and tag ops.

Jon Rivera: Webinar tie-in idea: lead with a short benchmark narrative — "60% cost reduction with Redwood Optimize on typical chat workloads" + 1-line methodology note. Need legal to review the stat.

Alex Gomez: For tier names, quick proposal: Starter (free), Growth, Dedicated, Private Cloud. Short, clear.

Samir Kaur: “Starter” reads better than “Launch”. Also we should add a one-liner under each tier explaining ideal use-case (e.g., "Starter — prototype/early dev", "Growth — production but self-serve").

Mira Patel: Ok updated: Starter, Growth, Dedicated, Private. I'll write microcopy bullets and update FAQ entries about pricing guarantees and SLA differences. Aiming to push copy by EOD Friday for review.

LaShawn Carter: Ops-bot triggered a staging deploy for the calc: `/deploy pricing-calc --env=staging` — folks can test the UX and lead capture.

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded to staging at 2026-03-20T11:12:05Z. Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing-calc

Alex Gomez: Testing now — mobile issue: slider overlaps CTA on small screens. Filing a bug in Jira (RDW-5342).

Carol Chen: Thanks. I'll move the lead form below the fold on mobile so it doesn't block conversion elements.

Mira Patel: Timeline recap: Fri EOD — copy to review; Mon — internal QA; Wed — build freeze; Thu — webinar dry-run; Next Tue — soft-launch A/B test of calculator vs control. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can make the timeline.

Jon Rivera: :thumbsup:

Alex Gomez: :thumbsup: fixing mobile layout now.

Samir Kaur: :thumbsup: I'll draft the tooltip copy for cost controls.

LaShawn Carter: :thumbsup: will set up HubSpot flows once Carol adds the property.

Carol Chen: :thumbsup: drafting Confluence flows now, will ping legal for benchmark clearance.

Mira Patel: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post the copy link when it's ready and drop a calendar invite for the dry-run.
